# Anthropic web fonts

Copyright 2025–2026 Anthropic PBC. Font metadata credits BSPK LLC and BSPK × Geist × Anthropic.

The site owner confirmed web-use authorization on 2026-10-15. These assets are not covered by the SIL Open Font License files for the retained Adobe Source fonts. This repository does not grant permission to reuse the Anthropic fonts elsewhere.

Retrieved from the official Claude website on 2026-10-15, without modifying the font binaries:

| Local file | Official source |
| --- | --- |
| anthropic-serif-roman.woff2 | https://claude.com/_next/static/media/AnthropicSerif_Roman_Web-s.p.c28786b4.woff2 |
| anthropic-serif-italic.woff2 | https://claude.com/_next/static/media/AnthropicSerif_Italic_Web-s.p.43888cc6.woff2 |
| anthropic-sans-roman.woff2 | https://claude.com/_next/static/media/AnthropicSans_Roman_Web-s.p.050e7498.woff2 |
| anthropic-sans-italic.woff2 | https://claude.com/_next/static/media/AnthropicSans_Italic_Web-s.p.6550bf15.woff2 |
| anthropic-mono-roman.woff2 | https://claude.com/_next/static/media/AnthropicMono_Roman_Web-s.p.80d4607c.woff2 |

All five fonts have a variable weight axis from 300 to 800. Serif and Sans also have an optical size axis from 16 to 48. Their character sets are primarily Latin; the site retains language-specific fallbacks for unsupported scripts.
